name: threeway_support
description: passage 하나에 대해 fact마다 Supported / Contradicted / Not mentioned 3택

questions.prompt: How does the passage relate to this statement?

instructions.title: Does the passage support, contradict, or ignore each statement?
instructions.summary: For each atomic statement, decide whether the passage supports it, contradicts it, or does not mention it.
instructions.background: We are measuring how faithfully a QA system's answer follows its retrieved evidence, including cases where the evidence says the opposite.
definitions: The passage states the claim or it follows directly.
The passage states something incompatible with the claim.
The passage gives no information either way.
howto: For every statement choose exactly one of the three.
Use only the passage, not outside knowledge.
instructions.tip: A statement about a different entity or time than the passage discusses is usually Not mentioned, not Contradicted.
